grades.upper_bound_mechanism: merge of progressions with residue counting mod L, plus fallacious backward induction
grades.notes: Key observation is false: supports need not be minimal hitting sets — its own example has 30 with support {2,3,5} properly containing {2,3}, contradicting Lemmas 1–3. Lemma 1's contradiction is vacuous (x_k is coprime to all earlier terms, hence not a valid candidate) and 'p_k > L_k' is false. No (C). Only eventual periodicity shown; 'uniqueness' backward step is fallacious.
